name: pronto-kanban
description: Pronto Kanban prototype: Bryntum TaskBoard over the Pronto tasks API, with a global rank service for drag ordering. Same auth and hosting pattern as the SOW Planner and Asset Library.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "node --watch server/index.js" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.build: node scripts/copy-base.mjs && npm run build --workspace web
